title: Mechanism-driven biomarkers to guide immune checkpoint blockade in cancer therapy

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Mechanism-driven biomarkers to guide immune checkpoint blockade in cancer therapy》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】With recent approvals for multiple therapeutic antibodies that block cytotoxic T lymphocyte associated antigen 4 (CTLA4) and programmed cell death protein 1 (PD1) in melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer and kidney cancer, and additional immune checkpoints being targeted clinically, many questions still remain regarding the optimal use of drugs that block these checkpoint pathways.
